title: Kula burn scar fencing and native replanting
summary: The Kula Community Watershed Alliance is fencing and replanting a steep burn scar, and as of September 9 over a thousand plants are in the fully fenced upper section. Its nursery holds over 30,000 plants, and over 200 deer have been removed in the past year. The group hopes more fencing will be finished by year's end so it can plant hundreds of thousands of native plants.
